scope: Data/native publication, durable URL policy and storage boundary

security_concerns.issue: insertSafe source predicate permits embedded NUL inside fixed-length video ID because SQLite GLOB text matching stops at NUL.
security_concerns.evidence: Actual CREATE_DOWNLOADS and insertSafe SQL accepted 43-byte canonical-prefix strings with an embedded NUL ID/suffix. Kotlin wrappers reject but the callable SQL boundary must enforce its own storage invariant.
security_concerns.required_fix: Add instr(:sourceUrl,char(0))=0 and regressions with embedded, not only appended, NUL.

summary: No other core journal, atomic completion, retry, import/delete, consent or native lifecycle blocker established. Parent independently identified pending MediaStore adapter issues; all final fixes must be re-reviewed together.
